crossRefs.note: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.
Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
Turn to the law and to the covenant! If they don’t speak according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.
The wise men are disappointed. They are dismayed and trapped. Behold, they have rejected Yahweh’s word. What kind of…
“The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.
But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness…
At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise…
Because knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, and didn’t give thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and…
but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn’t arrive at the law of righteousness.
Why? Because they didn’t seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone;
Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool, that he…
For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.”
But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.
knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts
They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.
Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.
Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.
Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.
He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.
For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance, but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken…
But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be…

translations.web: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.
translations.bsb: A mocker seeks wisdom and finds none, but knowledge comes easily to the discerning.
translations.kjv: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.
translations.asv: A scoffer seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not; But knowledge is easy unto him that hath understanding.
